title: Cloud City: Cheat Sheet: Key Numbers, Limits & SLAs for the PCA Exam
city_concept: City Standard Measures & Guild Hall Weights

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Every merchant in Cloud City used a different length of rope and a different weight of lead, causing endless trade disputes.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Grand Master Marcus cast standard brass weights and yardsticks (Key Numbers) displayed in the central Guild Hall.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: Every apprentice memorized the standard civic measures before being granted their master builder license.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Brass standards are preserved in glass cases; cloud architectural metrics guide mission-critical enterprise design globally.
